mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy easing supports valuation expansion.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods following a 3-month FEDFUNDS decline of at least 0.25pp, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment (UNRATE) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over the prior 3 months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit expectations.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by more than 0.3 percentage points over the prior 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances following a UNRATE increase of over 0.3pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS rising) and weak consumer demand (RSAFS below its 12-month moving average) signal a high probability of negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to compressed corporate margins and elevated discount rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises and RSAFS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production contraction (INDPRO below its 6-month moving average) during manufacturing slowdowns signals reduced corporate output and profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations adjust downward.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is below its 6-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 10% over the prior 3 months signals robust consumer confidence and economic momentum, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through increased construction activity and spending.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by more than 10% over the prior 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances following a HOUST increase of over 10% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained strength in real consumer spending (RSAFS above its 12-month moving average) compresses equity risk premiums and supports higher corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 2% over the prior 3 months signals manufacturing weakness and reduced economic activity, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as profit expectations decline.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by more than 2% over the prior 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances following an INDPRO decline of over 2% in 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous labor market tightening (PAYEMS growth above 0.5% monthly) and falling unemployment (UNRATE decreasing by more than 0.2pp over 3 months) signals strong economic momentum and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through elevated consumer spending and corporate investment.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly and UNRATE falls by more than 0.2pp over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
